chapter.verse: Sang Penpa’ liahna sungah a om mi, Vanglianpa’ liim sungah a om mi in,
Topa tungah, “Ka bukna leh ka munkip muanhuai, ka muan’ ka Pasian na hi hi,” a ci ding hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh amah in thangsiahpa’ thangzak leh a lauhuai pulnatna panin nangmah hong honkhia ding hi;
amah in a khate tawh nang hong tuam ding a, ama khate nuai-ah buk nading na mu ding hi; ama thumanna in nang hong dalin hong hu ding hi.
Nangmah in zan-a lauhuaina, sun-a thaltang leengte, khuamial lak-a a vak khiankhian pulnatna, sun nitaang-a suksiatnate na kihta kei ding hi.
Na kiangah mi tulkhat, na kimkotah mi tulsawm, hong tuk kha ding uh hi; ahih hangin tuate in na kiang nai hong neh lo ding hi.
Na mit tawh na en bek ding a, migilote a kithukkikna na mu ding hi.
Nangmah in Topa pen na buk nadingin bawlin, Sang Penpa, nang a hu dingin bawl khin na hih manin,
na tungah siatna hong tung lo ding a, na innah gimna hong tung lo ding hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh na lampi khempeuhah nangmah hong cing dingin amah in ama vantungmi nang hong kemsak ding hi.
Na khete in suang a suihkhak loh nadingin, amaute in a khut uh tawh nang hong dom ding uh hi.
Nangmah in humpinelkai leh gul gu nei tung na tawn ding a, na khe nuai-ah humpinelkai khang lai leh gulpi na tuancil ding hi.
Amah in itna tawh kei hong bel ahih manin amah ka honkhia ding a, amah in ka min thei ahih manin mun sangna-ah amah ka koih ding hi.
Amah in kei hong sap ciangin keimah in amah ka dawng ding hi; haksatna sungah amah ka ompih ding a, amah honkhia-in ka pahtawi ding hi.
Nuntak sau tawh amah ka lungkim sak ding a, amah ka honkhia ding hi.
